Ariyalurinland villages and cultivated plainsDry-season water reliabilityRainfall-sensitive crops and farm incomeHeat in homes, workplaces and institutionsOpen district brief +

Planning screen — local verification pending

Start with this local question

Which village water sources fail before the next dependable rains?

Three unranked starting problems to investigate. Conditions vary within the district; this is a planning screen, not a current warning or verified district risk assessment.

Dry-season water reliability

Practical problem to check
Check whether drinking-water sources, wells and storage remain dependable through dry months.
Response to assess
Prepare a seasonal water budget, test source quality and compare leak repair, demand reduction and hydrogeologically suitable recharge.
Local baseline
Monthly supply days, well levels, abstraction and water-quality tests.
What success would measure
Reliable service days and seasonal extraction, with water quality maintained.
Roles to appoint
Local body, water utility, hydrogeologist and participating water users.
Read the evidence and limits in K02 ↗

Rainfall-sensitive crops and farm income

Practical problem to check
Check crop-stage dry spells, excess-rain damage and income sensitivity for locally grown crops.
Response to assess
Co-design a small comparable farmer trial with KVK support: crop timing, locally suited varieties, soil cover and water budgeting.
Local baseline
Crop-wise multi-season yield, rainfall, labour, input costs and farm water use.
What success would measure
Yield stability and net return including household labour, compared across seasons.
Roles to appoint
Farmer group or FPO, KVK agronomist and independent evaluator.
Read the evidence and limits in K11 ↗

Heat in homes, workplaces and institutions

Practical problem to check
Check occupied indoor heat and outdoor work exposure, including humidity and access to shade.
Response to assess
Audit a school, health centre or worksite; compare roof treatment, shading, ventilation and professionally designed heat-response arrangements.
Local baseline
Occupied-hour indoor/outdoor temperature, humidity, occupancy and energy use.
What success would measure
Hours above an agreed comfort threshold; protected work periods; weather-adjusted electricity.
Roles to appoint
Building owner, facilities operator, occupational-health team and qualified designer.
Read the evidence and limits in K06 ↗

Chengalpattucoastal settlements, tanks and the urban fringeUrban waterlogging and polluted water bodiesCoastal storms, erosion and fishing accessHeat in homes, workplaces and institutionsOpen district brief +

Planning screen — local verification pending

Start with this local question

Which tank-linked settlements lose drainage or safe access during heavy rain?

Three unranked starting problems to investigate. Conditions vary within the district; this is a planning screen, not a current warning or verified district risk assessment.

Urban waterlogging and polluted water bodies

Practical problem to check
Check storm-drain connectivity, sewage inflows and low-lying homes or public buildings.
Response to assess
Trace catchments and inlets, separate pollution control from flood management, and compare utility repairs with retention and wetland options.
Local baseline
Drain connections, inlet flows and pollution loads; inundation records and treatment uptime.
What success would measure
Compliant treated flows; comparable-storm waterlogging duration; maintenance completed.
Roles to appoint
Municipal body, sewer/drainage utility, asset custodian and community representatives.
Read the evidence and limits in K03 ↗

Coastal storms, erosion and fishing access

Practical problem to check
Check exposed shore settlements, boat access, shelter routes and seasonal shoreline change.
Response to assess
Assess sediment and coastal hazards before selecting setbacks, dunes, habitat recovery or engineered protection; protect fishing access and neighbouring shores.
Local baseline
Seasonal beach profiles, shoreline history, exposure and evacuation travel time.
What success would measure
Exposure avoided; livelihood access retained; shoreline response monitored.
Roles to appoint
Coastal authority, district administration, fisheries teams and fishing communities.
Read the evidence and limits in K08 ↗

Planning screen — local verification pending

Start with this local question

Which coastal and river-adjacent settlements need compound-flood access planning?

Three unranked starting problems to investigate. Conditions vary within the district; this is a planning screen, not a current warning or verified district risk assessment.

Coastal storms, erosion and fishing access

Practical problem to check
Check exposed shore settlements, boat access, shelter routes and seasonal shoreline change.
Response to assess
Assess sediment and coastal hazards before selecting setbacks, dunes, habitat recovery or engineered protection; protect fishing access and neighbouring shores.
Local baseline

What success would measure
Exposure avoided; livelihood access retained; shoreline response monitored.

Read the evidence and limits in K08 ↗

River floods and access disruption

Practical problem to check
Check floodplain settlements, drainage bottlenecks and routes that may become unusable during heavy rain.
Response to assess
Combine official flood maps with local flood marks; protect flow paths and assess retention, warning reach and accessible evacuation routes.
Local baseline
Observed inundation depth/duration, rainfall, drainage connections and affected essential services.
What success would measure
Comparable-event access and service interruption; warning-to-action time.
Roles to appoint
District disaster authority, local body, irrigation engineers and affected communities.
Read the evidence and limits in K04 ↗

Salinity and dependable freshwater

Practical problem to check
Check seasonal saltwater intrusion or saline sources before treating a freshwater shortage as a quantity-only problem.
Response to assess
Test conductivity and relevant water-quality parameters through wet and dry periods; assess source protection and demand management with water specialists.
Local baseline
Seasonal conductivity, water-quality tests, source availability and abstraction.
What success would measure
Water meeting the intended-use standard and reliable freshwater service days.
Roles to appoint
Water utility, accredited laboratory, hydrogeologist and local users.
Read the evidence and limits in K01 ↗

Slope instability and intense hill rainfall

Practical problem to check
Check steep inhabited slopes, road cuts and drainage against official landslide-susceptibility information.
Response to assess
Arrange geotechnical inspection, drainage review and last-mile warnings; prioritise exposure reduction and safe access before structural works.
Local baseline
Slope geology, failure history, rainfall, drainage and households in possible runout paths.
What success would measure
People with viable evacuation access; warning response; inspected drainage maintained.
Roles to appoint
District disaster authority, geotechnical specialists, road agency and local communities.

Habitat condition and catchment protection

Practical problem to check
Check native habitat, invasive spread and erosion in catchments supporting people and wildlife.
Response to assess
Map the original habitat and rights first; trial appropriate native recovery and invasive control with repeat maintenance, rather than assume every open site needs trees.
Local baseline
Native cover, invasive cover, soil condition, regeneration and community resource use.
What success would measure
Native recovery and habitat function; invasive rebound; livelihood access retained.
Roles to appoint
Habitat custodian, restoration ecologist and rights-holding communities.

Local baseline
Monthly supply days, well levels, abstraction and water-quality tests.

Reliable service days and seasonal extraction, with water quality maintained.

Local body, water utility, hydrogeologist and participating water users.

Which current mandals retain a verified need after Markapuram reorganisation?

Three unranked starting problems to investigate. Conditions vary within the district; this is a planning screen, not a current warning or verified district risk assessment.

Dry-season water reliability

Practical problem to check
Check whether drinking-water sources, wells and storage remain dependable through dry months.
Response to assess
Prepare a seasonal water budget, test source quality and compare leak repair, demand reduction and hydrogeologically suitable recharge.
Local baseline
Monthly supply days, well levels, abstraction and water-quality tests.
What success would measure
Reliable service days and seasonal extraction, with water quality maintained.
Roles to appoint
Local body, water utility, hydrogeologist and participating water users.

Rainfall-sensitive crops and farm income

Practical problem to check
Check crop-stage dry spells, excess-rain damage and income sensitivity for locally grown crops.
Response to assess
Co-design a small comparable farmer trial with KVK support: crop timing, locally suited varieties, soil cover and water budgeting.
Local baseline
Crop-wise multi-season yield, rainfall, labour, input costs and farm water use.
What success would measure
Yield stability and net return including household labour, compared across seasons.
Roles to appoint
Farmer group or FPO, KVK agronomist and independent evaluator.

Coastal authority, district administration, fisheries teams and fishing communities.

Adilabadnorthern plateau farms and forest-edge settlementsHeat in homes, workplaces and institutionsRainfall-sensitive crops and farm incomeDry-season water reliabilityOpen district brief +

Planning screen — local verification pending

Start with this local question

Which farmer and worker groups can document heat and crop-stage water exposure?

Three unranked starting problems to investigate. Conditions vary within the district; this is a planning screen, not a current warning or verified district risk assessment.

Heat in homes, workplaces and institutions

Practical problem to check
Check occupied indoor heat and outdoor work exposure, including humidity and access to shade.
Response to assess
Audit a school, health centre or worksite; compare roof treatment, shading, ventilation and professionally designed heat-response arrangements.
Local baseline
Occupied-hour indoor/outdoor temperature, humidity, occupancy and energy use.
What success would measure
Hours above an agreed comfort threshold; protected work periods; weather-adjusted electricity.
Roles to appoint
Building owner, facilities operator, occupational-health team and qualified designer.
Read the evidence and limits in K06 ↗

Rainfall-sensitive crops and farm income

Practical problem to check
Check crop-stage dry spells, excess-rain damage and income sensitivity for locally grown crops.
Response to assess
Co-design a small comparable farmer trial with KVK support: crop timing, locally suited varieties, soil cover and water budgeting.
Local baseline
Crop-wise multi-season yield, rainfall, labour, input costs and farm water use.
What success would measure
Yield stability and net return including household labour, compared across seasons.
Roles to appoint
Farmer group or FPO, KVK agronomist and independent evaluator.
Read the evidence and limits in K11 ↗

Dry-season water reliability

Practical problem to check
Check whether drinking-water sources, wells and storage remain dependable through dry months.
Response to assess
Prepare a seasonal water budget, test source quality and compare leak repair, demand reduction and hydrogeologically suitable recharge.
Local baseline
Monthly supply days, well levels, abstraction and water-quality tests.
What success would measure
Reliable service days and seasonal extraction, with water quality maintained.
Roles to appoint
Local body, water utility, hydrogeologist and participating water users.
Read the evidence and limits in K02 ↗

River floods and access disruption

Practical problem to check
Check floodplain settlements, drainage bottlenecks and routes that may become unusable during heavy rain.
Response to assess

Observed inundation depth/duration, rainfall, drainage connections and affected essential services.

Comparable-event access and service interruption; warning-to-action time.

Habitat condition and catchment protection

Practical problem to check
Check native habitat, invasive spread and erosion in catchments supporting people and wildlife.
Response to assess
Map the original habitat and rights first; trial appropriate native recovery and invasive control with repeat maintenance, rather than assume every open site needs trees.
Local baseline
Native cover, invasive cover, soil condition, regeneration and community resource use.

Roles to appoint
Habitat custodian, restoration ecologist and rights-holding communities.

Karimnagarurban institutions and agricultural water systemsHeat in homes, workplaces and institutionsUrban waterlogging and polluted water bodiesRainfall-sensitive crops and farm incomeOpen district brief +

Planning screen — local verification pending

Start with this local question

Which institution and catchment can support a small measurable resilience pilot?

Three unranked starting problems to investigate. Conditions vary within the district; this is a planning screen, not a current warning or verified district risk assessment.

Heat in homes, workplaces and institutions

Practical problem to check
Check occupied indoor heat and outdoor work exposure, including humidity and access to shade.
Response to assess
Audit a school, health centre or worksite; compare roof treatment, shading, ventilation and professionally designed heat-response arrangements.
Local baseline
Occupied-hour indoor/outdoor temperature, humidity, occupancy and energy use.
What success would measure
Hours above an agreed comfort threshold; protected work periods; weather-adjusted electricity.
Roles to appoint
Building owner, facilities operator, occupational-health team and qualified designer.
Read the evidence and limits in K06 ↗

Urban waterlogging and polluted water bodies

Practical problem to check
Check storm-drain connectivity, sewage inflows and low-lying homes or public buildings.
Response to assess
Trace catchments and inlets, separate pollution control from flood management, and compare utility repairs with retention and wetland options.
Local baseline
Drain connections, inlet flows and pollution loads; inundation records and treatment uptime.
What success would measure
Compliant treated flows; comparable-storm waterlogging duration; maintenance completed.
Roles to appoint
Municipal body, sewer/drainage utility, asset custodian and community representatives.
Read the evidence and limits in K03 ↗

Rainfall-sensitive crops and farm income

Practical problem to check
Check crop-stage dry spells, excess-rain damage and income sensitivity for locally grown crops.
Response to assess
Co-design a small comparable farmer trial with KVK support: crop timing, locally suited varieties, soil cover and water budgeting.
Local baseline
Crop-wise multi-season yield, rainfall, labour, input costs and farm water use.
What success would measure
Yield stability and net return including household labour, compared across seasons.
Roles to appoint
Farmer group or FPO, KVK agronomist and independent evaluator.
Read the evidence and limits in K11 ↗

Which farm-water measures preserve community rights and native habitat?

Three unranked starting problems to investigate. Conditions vary within the district; this is a planning screen, not a current warning or verified district risk assessment.

Dry-season water reliability

Practical problem to check
Check whether drinking-water sources, wells and storage remain dependable through dry months.
Response to assess
Prepare a seasonal water budget, test source quality and compare leak repair, demand reduction and hydrogeologically suitable recharge.
Local baseline
Monthly supply days, well levels, abstraction and water-quality tests.
What success would measure
Reliable service days and seasonal extraction, with water quality maintained.
Roles to appoint
Local body, water utility, hydrogeologist and participating water users.
Read the evidence and limits in K02 ↗

Rainfall-sensitive crops and farm income

Practical problem to check
Check crop-stage dry spells, excess-rain damage and income sensitivity for locally grown crops.
Response to assess
Co-design a small comparable farmer trial with KVK support: crop timing, locally suited varieties, soil cover and water budgeting.
Local baseline
Crop-wise multi-season yield, rainfall, labour, input costs and farm water use.
What success would measure
Yield stability and net return including household labour, compared across seasons.
Roles to appoint
Farmer group or FPO, KVK agronomist and independent evaluator.
Read the evidence and limits in K11 ↗

Habitat condition and catchment protection

Practical problem to check
Check native habitat, invasive spread and erosion in catchments supporting people and wildlife.
Response to assess
Map the original habitat and rights first; trial appropriate native recovery and invasive control with repeat maintenance, rather than assume every open site needs trees.
Local baseline
Native cover, invasive cover, soil condition, regeneration and community resource use.
What success would measure
Native recovery and habitat function; invasive rebound; livelihood access retained.
Roles to appoint
Habitat custodian, restoration ecologist and rights-holding communities.
Read the evidence and limits in K15 ↗

WHAT IS VERIFIED. WHAT STILL NEEDS WORK.

Keep the geography and the evidence honest.

Current district coverage

  • Tamil Nadu · 38 districts
  • Kerala · 14 districts
  • Karnataka · 31 districts
  • Andhra Pradesh · 28 districts
  • Telangana · 33 districts

Andhra Pradesh’s directory lists 28 districts, including Markapuram and Polavaram. The official Bengaluru South website records the rename from Ramanagara on 23 May 2025. Historical reports may cover older districts and taluks; never transfer their totals or rankings without a boundary crosswalk.

This district edition covers the five states requested. Puducherry and Lakshadweep coverage remains in the regional bank.

Evidence depth

District names checked against government directories. Contexts, questions, problem selections and proposed actions are POIGAI planning synthesis using regional briefs and district source routes, not 144 completed district risk assessments. No severity ranking or confirmed local unmet need is claimed. Consult the cited district plan/maps and obtain local measurements before project selection.

The state evidence links are starting routes, not proof that all district reports or map layers were read. Selected district-plan landing pages and research summaries are labelled within the relevant brief. A disaster plan may cover non-climate hazards; this directory selects climate-related questions without attributing every event to climate change.

Records are manually reviewed, not live alerts. Follow dated official warnings and local authorities for urgent decisions.

From profile to a real project

Record the exact location, measured baseline, confirmed unmet need, implementation partner, maintenance owner, costed design and measurable outcome. Verify community consent, permissions, technical suitability, current schemes and downstream effects. Price assessment, implementation, operation, monitoring and replacement separately.

Send a public district study, plan, map, correction or locally measured baseline to contact@poigai.com. Include its date, geography, method and limitations. It will require editorial review before publication.

PUBLIC AND REUSABLE

Use the directory in the field.

Download all district questions, problem–response options, evidence routes and verification needs. Printing uses your current district filters, so choose a district or state first.
